title: Torrent Pharma Executive Director Amal Kelshikar Resigns

contentHtml:
Ahmedabad: Torrent Pharmaceuticals Limited has announced the resignation of Amal Kelshikar from the position of Executive Director and Senior Management Personnel (SMP), effective from the close of business hours on October 16, 2026.

In his resignation letter addressed to the Managing Director, Kelshikar stated that the decision followed thoughtful reflection and that he believed it was the right time to transition from his role. He also expressed gratitude to the company’s management and colleagues for their continued support, trust and cooperation throughout his association with Torrent Pharmaceuticals.

Kelshikar acknowledged the responsibilities and opportunities entrusted to him over the years, including his extended tenure beyond superannuation. He described the experience as valuable to his professional and personal journey.

He further conveyed his appreciation for being part of the company and committed to supporting a smooth transition and completing the necessary handover formalities.

The company submitted the required disclosures along with the resignation letter as part of its regulatory filing. The announcement did not specify a successor or provide further details regarding the reasons for the resignation.
